# Your account

Your account area is where you manage everything about _you_ — your profile, how you
sign in, your privacy, and how the app looks and behaves. It's organised into sections
you move between from a sidebar, so each concern has its own focused page.

## Profile

Your name, date of birth, email, and contact number, plus your picture. Everything shows
read-only at a glance, and you edit any card by opening its Change or Edit button — so
you're never typing into a form by accident.

For your picture you can upload a photo or pick a generated portrait from a gallery of
styles (with a Shuffle to try variations). It's one or the other: choosing a portrait
clears an uploaded photo, and vice versa. If you set neither, your initials stand in.

There's also an "at a glance" card — when you joined, when you were last active, and
running counts of your transactions, the people and merchants you've added, and your
active recurring items.

## Security

Everything about proving it's really you:

- **Password** — change it any time.
- **Recovery question** — one security question you can set or replace, used if you ever
  need to recover access.
- **Email** — changing it takes two steps: we send a code to the new address to confirm
  it's yours, and a heads-up to your current address so a change can never happen quietly
  behind your back.
- **Two-factor authentication** — turn on a second sign-in step using an authenticator
  app. When you enable it we show you a set of one-time backup codes to save somewhere
  safe; that screen won't close by accident, because those codes are shown only once.
- **Active sessions** — every place you're currently signed in, with the device and
  when it was last used. You can sign out any of them.
- **Trusted devices** — the devices that have already cleared our new-device email check.
  Forget one and it'll have to verify by email again next time.

## Privacy

- **Export your data** — download your information, choosing which parts you want and
  whether you'd like CSV or JSON. Pick one and you get that file; pick several and you
  get a single zip.
- **Clean restart** — wipe all your financial data while keeping your account, login,
  and settings. Because it can't be undone, we walk you through it and nudge you to back
  up first — if there's data you haven't downloaded yet, we'll offer to export it before
  anything is deleted.
- **Delete account** — schedule your whole account for removal. We email you a link to
  cancel in case you change your mind.

## Accessibility

How the app looks and reads _on this device_: light or dark theme, text size, reduced
motion, higher contrast, always-underlined links, an always-visible focus outline, and a
privacy mask that blurs money amounts so nothing sensitive shows on your screen in public.
This section also holds display choices like your date format, number format, and which
page you land on when you sign in.

These are settings for the device you're on. They live in this browser and stay put here —
they don't travel with you to your phone or another computer. That's on purpose: how big
text should be depends on the screen in front of you.

## Preferences

Your region, currency, and timezone — the settings that shape how money and dates appear
everywhere in the app. Change your country and we'll fill in a sensible currency and
timezone to match, which you can then adjust.

Unlike the accessibility settings, **these follow you across every device you sign in
from** — set them once and they're the same everywhere. A couple of quick toggles live
here too, like your default kind of transaction and whether tax bills finalize
automatically each week.

## Notifications

Choose which kinds of updates you want to hear about. Each type of alert or notification
the app can raise has its own switch, so you can quiet the ones you don't care about and
keep the ones you do.
